scope: Host-only shared build/flash record, explicit file list and changed-document validation. No new firmware compilation or device operation.

validation.independent_review: Read-only gpt-6.1-sol/medium review identified anchor handling bugs; corrected and regression covered. Final review found no definite blocker.

failures_preserved: Strict build check correctly rejected four CRLF-only sources; original ZIP matched original hashes before line-ending exception.
Historical stage2.sources rejected current compass_protocol.py bytes; historical record was not changed.
Initial test fixture used CRLF with autocrlf disabled and failed diff --check; fixture now writes LF.
First docs check matched its own corruption-marker literal; marker is now escaped.
Initial input-list preparation used a nonexistent guessed fixture filename and wrote no output; corrected after directory inventory.
limits: Checks recorded build inputs, not dependency completeness; new inputs need a new build.
Build and flash records do not attest current board identity or session continuity.
Markdown checker covers added inline/reference links, ATX headings and explicit anchors, not a full Markdown renderer or semantic review.
No cross-session passed-result cache, SDK lock change, build, flash, port enumeration, reset or clock write.
